mapper.select: SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, c.category_code AS categoryCode, c.parent_category_id AS parentCategoryId, p.category_code AS parentCategoryCode, COUNT(*) AS paymentCount, SUM(e.amount) AS totalAmount FROM expense e JOIN category c ON c.category_id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_category_id WHERE e.member_id = #{memberId} AND e.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, c.category_code, c.parent_category_id, p.category_code ORDER BY SUM(e.amount) DESC, c.category_id

SELECT e.payment_date AS paymentDate, e.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.merchant_code AS merchantCode, c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_code AS categoryCode, c.parent_category_id AS parentCategoryId, p.category_code AS parentCategoryCode, e.amount AS amount, e.payment_type AS paymentType FROM expense e JOIN category c ON c.category_id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.merchant_id = e.merchant_id WHERE e.member_id = #{memberId} AND e.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY e.payment_date, e.expense_id
